$comment: Describes content/portfolio.json for the portfolio admin app. Field order is the order fields are stored and shown.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Search description
fields.hint: Shown by search engines under the title. Aim for 150–160 characters.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Full name
fields.hint: Hero heading, footer and copyright line.

fields.name: shortName
fields.label: Short name
fields.hint: Header, next to the logo.

fields.name: initials
fields.label: Initials
fields.hint: The letters in the logo mark.

fields.name: role
fields.label: Role
fields.hint: Label above your name in the hero, and in the footer.

fields.name: headerTagline
fields.label: Header tagline
fields.hint: Small line under your name in the header.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.hint: Contact section and footer. Leave empty to hide.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone
fields.hint: Leave empty to hide.

fields.name: linkedin
fields.label: LinkedIn
fields.hint: Leave empty to hide.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.hint: Contact section only. Leave empty to hide.

fields.name: experience
fields.label: Years of experience
fields.hint: Hero fact, shown as "3.3 yrs". Also update the first About paragraph.

fields.name: currentClient
fields.label: Current client
fields.hint: Hero fact and the Expertise intro.

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Photo
fields.hint: Hero photo. A portrait with a plain background works best. Leave empty to hide.

fields.name: resumeAuto
fields.label: Generate CV automatically from this portfolio
fields.hint: On: every save rebuilds the CV (PDF and Word) from your profile, summary, skills, experience, expertise and education. Off: visitors download the files uploaded below.

fields.name: resumeUrl
fields.label: CV / resume file
fields.hint: Used when automatic CV is off. PDF or Word.

fields.name: resumeAltUrl
fields.label: CV in another format
fields.hint: Optional, used when automatic CV is off: the same CV in the other format. Visitors then choose which to download.

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: The paragraph under your name.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: About paragraphs
fields.hint: One paragraph per line.

fields.name: coreConcepts
fields.label: Core concepts
fields.hint: One per line. The bullet list in the "Core concepts" card.

fields.name: score
fields.label: Score
fields.hint: Optional. Shown in brackets after the year.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Contact intro
fields.hint: The sentence under "Let's talk Workday Finance".

modules.label: Modules
modules.description: The Workday Financials tiles. A module whose name matches a skill icon (e.g. "General Ledger") gets that icon and colour.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Description
fields.hint: One line.

processFlows.label: Processes
processFlows.description: The tabbed "How finance flows" section. The first process is the tab that opens first.

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Caption
fields.hint: The sentence next to the title.

fields.name: steps
fields.label: Steps
fields.hint: The numbered boxes, in order.

fields.name: items
fields.label: What was configured
fields.hint: One per line.

workAreas.label: Expertise
workAreas.idHint: Also picks the card icon (general-ledger, procure-to-pay, accounts-receivable, fixed-assets, worktags-organizations, security-business-processes, eib-data-migration, reporting-support). Other IDs get a briefcase.

fields.name: responsibilities
fields.label: Responsibilities
fields.hint: One per line. The first 3 show; the rest appear behind "Show N more".

fields.name: tech
fields.label: Tags
fields.hint: One per line.

fields.name: isCurrent
fields.label: This is my current job (green date pill)

fields.name: project.name
fields.label: Project name
fields.hint: Optional project fact box. Leave the name empty to hide it.

fields.name: highlights
fields.label: Highlights
fields.hint: One per line.

skillGroups.label: Skills
skillGroups.description: Each group is one box of skills. Skill icons are matched from the skill name.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Skills
fields.hint: One per line.

pages.label: Profile
pages.description: Name, contact details, photo and CV.

pages.label: Hero & SEO
pages.description: The top of the page and what search engines show.
